runtime_references.command:
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 4 \\( -name AGENTS.md -o -path './openspec/*' \\) -print
printf '\\nTeardown references:\\n'
grep -RInE 'teardown_(request|appcontext)|appcontext_tearing_down|request_tearing_down|do_teardown' src/flask tests | head -240
printf '\\nGit status:\\n'
git status --short"
